Breakfast · Medium

Oats Uttapam & Salsa

A powerful breakfast that is rich in nutrition and incredible in its taste. Serve this one hot and see your kids licking their fingers on this one.

10 minPreparation
15 minCooking
6Servings

Ingredients

For 6 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. For the salsa, in a bowl, combine chopped onion, capsicum and coriander leaves with 1 cup of Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.
  2. For the uttapam, in a bowl, combine the yoghurt, semolina, oats salt and 1 cup water.
  3. Cover and set aside for 2 hours.
  4. Add the onion, green chilli, tomato and chilli powder to the batter.
  5. Heat a non-stick pan and spread 1 tablespoon batter on it.
  6. Cook on low heat, drizzling oil around the edges. Turn the uttapam over and cook the other side as well. Remove from heat. Prepare the rest of the uttapams in the same way.
